Business Jargon Generator

Generate grammatically correct corporate buzzword phrases — 'Let's leverage our synergistic ecosystem' — from real word banks.

Warning: using more than three of these per meeting may cause spontaneous eye-rolling.

📖 How to use

  1. Press Generate Jargon.
  2. Read five fresh corporate phrases.
  3. Click any phrase to copy it.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Are the phrases grammatical?

The generator combines verbs, adjectives, nouns, and adverbs into proper sentence templates, so every phrase reads like real meeting-speak.

How many phrases per click?

Each click builds 5 fresh phrases from dozens of verbs, adjectives, nouns, and adverbs.

Can I copy a phrase?

Click any phrase to copy it straight to your clipboard.
